    function bindVoiceControls(){refreshVoices();$("#voiceSelect").addEventListener("change",()=>{stopSpeech();state.voiceChoice[state.lang]=$("#voiceSelect").value;saveState()});$("#voiceSampleBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>{demo.playing=false;clearProcedureTimer();state.voice=true;renderAll();speak(state.lang==="ta"?"மண்புழுவின் உடல் பல கண்டங்களால் ஆனது. கிளைட்டெல்லம் எனப்படும் சுரப்புப் பட்டை, XIV–XVI கண்டங்களில் அமைந்துள்ளது. மண்புழு ஈரமான தோல் வழியாகச் சுவாசிக்கிறது. இப்போது ஒரு பகுதியைத் தேர்ந்தெடுத்து, அதன் அமைப்பையும் பணியையும் அறிந்துகொள்ளலாம்.":"The earthworm has a segmented body. Its moist skin is the surface for gas exchange. Select a structure to hear about its function.")})}
    function showVoiceWarning(reason="unavailable"){const el=$("#voiceWarning"),ta=state.lang==="ta";el.textContent=reason==="error"?(ta?"குரல் விளக்கத்தை இயக்க முடியவில்லை. மீண்டும் முயலவும் அல்லது வேறொரு குரலைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்.":"Narration could not play. Install one in the device text-to-speech settings, then retry.");el.classList.add("show");announce(el.textContent)}
    function finishNarration(job,result){if(speechJob!==job)return;clearTimeout(job.timer);speechJob=null;job.utterance=null;job.resolve(result)}
    function cancelNarration(){const old=speechJob;if(old)finishNarration(old,"cancelled");nativeSend({type:"stop"});try{window.speechSynthesis?.cancel()}catch(_){}}
    function failNarration(job,reason="error"){if(speechJob!==job)return;showVoiceWarning(reason);finishNarration(job,"error");nativeSend({type:"stop"});try{window.speechSynthesis?.cancel()}catch(_){}}
    function nextSpeechChunk(job){if(speechJob!==job)return;clearTimeout(job.timer);job.index++;if(job.index>=job.chunks.length){finishNarration(job,"ended");return}job.timer=setTimeout(()=>playSpeechChunk(job),160)}
    function playSpeechChunk(job){if(speechJob!==job)return;const text=job.chunks[job.index],id=job.id+"-"+job.index;job.chunkId=id;
      // Engines can fail to send completion. A timeout stops this step; it never advances the demonstration.
      job.timer=setTimeout(()=>failNarration(job),Math.max(20000,text.length*180/job.rate));
      if(nativeSend({type:"speak",text,lang:job.lang==="ta"?"ta-IN":"en-IN",rate:job.rate,voice:job.voice?.voiceURI||"",id}))return;
      try{const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);job.utterance=u;u.voice=job.voice;u.lang=job.lang==="ta"?"ta-IN":"en-IN";u.rate=job.rate;u.pitch=1;u.volume=1;u.onend=()=>{if(speechJob===job&&job.chunkId===id)nextSpeechChunk(job)};u.onerror=e=>{if(speechJob===job){if(["canceled","interrupted"].includes(e.error))finishNarration(job,"cancelled");else failNarration(job)}};window.speechSynthesis.speak(u)}catch(_){failNarration(job)}
    }
    function beginNarration(job){if(speechJob!==job)return;job.waitingVoices=false;const list=localVoices(job.lang);job.voice=list.find(v=>v.voiceURI===state.voiceChoice[job.lang])||list[0];if(!job.voice&&!window.EarthwormNative){failNarration(job,"unavailable");return}$("#voiceWarning").classList.remove("show");playSpeechChunk(job)}
    function speak(text,lang=state.lang){cancelNarration();if(!state.voice||!text)return Promise.resolve("skipped");const clean=normalizeSpeechText(text,lang),chunks=splitSpeechText(clean);if(!chunks.length)return Promise.resolve("skipped");return new Promise(resolve=>{const job={id:Date.now().toString(36)+"-"+(++speechSerial),lang,rate:state.speechRate,chunks,index:0,resolve,timer:null};speechJob=job;if(!window.EarthwormNative&&!window.speechSynthesis){failNarration(job,"unavailable");return}refreshVoices();if(!window.EarthwormNative&&!localVoices(lang).length){job.waitingVoices=true;job.timer=setTimeout(()=>beginNarration(job),1200)}else beginNarration(job)})}
    function handleNativeMessage(e){try{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.type==="voices-loading"){setTimeout(()=>nativeSend({type:"voices"}),1800);return}if(m.type==="voices"){nativeVoices=Array.isArray(m.voices)?m.voices:[];renderVoiceControls();return}if(m.type==="print-finished"){document.body.classList.remove("print-atlas","print-certificate");return}const job=speechJob;if(!job||m.id!==job.chunkId)return;if(m.type==="voice-ended")nextSpeechChunk(job);else if(m.type==="voice-unavailable")failNarration(job,"unavailable");else if(m.type==="voice-error")failNarration(job);else if(m.type==="voice-ready")$("#voiceWarning").classList.remove("show")}catch(_){}}

    function announce(s){$("#live").textContent="";requestAnimationFrame(()=>$("#live").textContent=s)}

    function updateSvgLanguage(root=$("#anatomySvg")){root?.querySelectorAll("text").forEach(el=>{const original=el.dataset.enLabel||el.textContent.trim();if(!el.dataset.enLabel){el.dataset.enLabel=original;el.dataset.enX=el.getAttribute("x")||"0";el.dataset.enY=el.getAttribute("y")||"0";el.dataset.enFont=el.style.fontSize||""}const ta=state.lang==="ta",plan=ta?SVG_TA_LAYOUT[original]:null;el.replaceChildren();el.setAttribute("lang",ta?"ta":"en");el.setAttribute("xml:lang",ta?"ta":"en");el.setAttribute("x",plan?.x??el.dataset.enX);el.setAttribute("y",plan?.y??el.dataset.enY);el.style.fontSize=plan?plan.size+"px":el.dataset.enFont;const lines=plan?.lines||[ta?(SVG_TA[original]||original):original];lines.forEach((line,i)=>{const span=document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","tspan");span.setAttribute("x",el.getAttribute("x"));span.setAttribute("dy",i?"1.55em":"0");span.textContent=(i?" ":"")+line;el.append(span)})})}

    const VENTRAL_EXTERNAL_TARGETS=new Set(["mouth","spermathecal-pores","female-pore","male-pores"]);
    function requiredExternalView(){if(state.system!=="external")return state.externalView;const {step}=currentStep();return state.mode==="guided"&&step?(VENTRAL_EXTERNAL_TARGETS.has(step.target)?"ventral":"dorsal"):state.externalView}
    function renderExternalView(){const active=requiredExternalView(),controls=$("#externalViewControls");controls.hidden=state.system!=="external"||!["explore","review"].includes(state.mode);controls.setAttribute("aria-label",tr("externalSurface"));controls.querySelectorAll("[data-external-view]").forEach(btn=>{const view=btn.dataset.externalView;btn.textContent=view==="dorsal"?tr("dorsalSurface"):tr("ventralSurface");btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(active===view))});$$("#layer-external .external-view").forEach(view=>view.classList.toggle("active",view.dataset.externalSurface===active))}
    function activeStructure(id){return [...document.querySelectorAll(`[data-target="${id}"],[data-structure="${id}"]`)].find(el=>el.closest(".layer")?.classList.contains("active")&&(!el.closest(".external-view")||el.closest(".external-view").classList.contains("active")))}
    function renderAll(){
      document.documentElement.lang=state.lang==="ta"?"ta":"en";document.documentElement.dataset.lang=state.lang;$("#appTitle").textContent=tr("title");$("#appSubtitle").innerHTML=tr("subtitle");$$('[data-ui]').forEach(el=>{const k=el.dataset.ui;el.textContent=tr(k)});$("#skipLink").textContent=tr("skip");$(".header-actions").setAttribute("aria-label",tr("controls"));$("#systemNav").setAttribute("aria-label",tr("systems"));$(".side").setAttribute("aria-label",tr("learningControls"));$("#langBtn").setAttribute("aria-label",state.lang==="ta"?"Switch to English":"தமிழுக்கு மாற்று");
      $("#stageTitle").textContent=tr("tray");$("#stageHint").textContent=tr("hint");$("#specimenBadge").textContent=state.system==="crosssection"?(state.lang==="ta"?"குடற்பகுதி · குறுக்குவெட்டு":"Intestinal region · transverse section"):state.system==="external"?`${tr("externalSpecimen")} · ${requiredExternalView()==="dorsal"?tr("dorsalSurface"):tr("ventralSurface")}`:tr("specimen");$("#toolsTitle").textContent=tr("tools");$("#procedureBtnText").textContent=ptr("button");$("#printAtlasText").textContent=state.lang==="ta"?"பெயரிடப்பட்ட வரைபடம்":"Labelled diagram";
      $("#scopeSummary").textContent=tr("scope");$("#scopeContent").innerHTML=tr("scopeHtml");const ref=REFERENCE_CONTENT[state.lang];$("#taxonomySummary").textContent=state.lang==="ta"?"வகைப்பாடும் பெயரிடலும்":"Taxonomy and nomenclature";$("#taxonomyContent").innerHTML=ref.taxonomy;$("#advancedSummary").textContent=state.lang==="ta"?"உடற்சுவர், இயக்கம், முட்டைக்கூடு மற்றும் மீளுருவாக்கம்":"Body wall, locomotion, cocoon and regeneration";$("#advancedContent").innerHTML=ref.advanced;$("#comparisonSummary").textContent=state.lang==="ta"?"Metaphire–Lumbricus ஒப்பீடு":"Metaphire–Lumbricus comparison";$("#comparisonContent").innerHTML=ref.comparison;$("#bibliographySummary").textContent=state.lang==="ta"?"மேற்கோள்களும் ஆதாரத் தடமும்":"References and evidence trail";$("#bibliographyContent").innerHTML=ref.bibliography;
      $("#svgTitle").textContent=state.lang==="ta"?"தேர்ந்தெடுக்கக்கூடிய மண்புழுப் உடற்கூறாய்வு வரைபடம்":"Interactive earthworm dissection diagram";$("#svgDesc").textContent=state.lang==="ta"?"Metaphire posthuma-வின் கல்விசார் உடற்கூறாய்வு வரைபடம்; உடற்கூற்று மண்டலங்களைத் தொடுதல் அல்லது விசைப்பலகை மூலம் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கலாம்.":"An educational dissection diagram of Metaphire posthuma with selectable anatomical systems.";$("#procedureSvgTitle").textContent=state.lang==="ta"?"இயங்குபட முதுகுப்புறப் உடற்கூறாய்வு செய்முறை":"Animated dorsal dissection procedure";updateSvgLanguage();
      $(".zoom-dock").setAttribute("aria-label",tr("zoomControls"));$("#zoomIn").setAttribute("aria-label",tr("zoomIn"));$("#zoomOut").setAttribute("aria-label",tr("zoomOut"));$("#zoomReset").setAttribute("aria-label",tr("resetView"));$("#progressBar").setAttribute("aria-label",tr("moduleProgress"));$("#procedureProgress").setAttribute("aria-label",state.lang==="ta"?"வரைகலைச் செய்முறை முன்னேற்றம்":"Graphical procedure progress");$(".procedure-controls").setAttribute("aria-label",state.lang==="ta"?"வரைகலைச் செய்முறை கட்டுப்பாடுகள்":"Graphical procedure controls");
      $("#resetTitle").textContent=tr("resetTitle");$("#resetText").textContent=tr("resetText");$("#confirmReset").textContent=tr("reset");$("#resetDialog [data-close-dialog]:not(.close-x)").textContent=tr("cancel");$$("dialog .close-x").forEach(btn=>btn.setAttribute("aria-label",tr("close")));
      document.body.classList.toggle("high-contrast",state.contrast);$("#soundBtn").setAttribute("aria-pressed",state.sound);$("#voiceBtn").setAttribute("aria-pressed",state.voice);$("#contrastBtn").setAttribute("aria-pressed",state.contrast);renderTabs();renderModes();renderTools();renderLayer();renderProcedure();renderInstruction();renderProgress();updateA11y();if(!firstRender)saveState();firstRender=false;renderEnhancements();renderHQAtlas();if(selectedId&&STRUCTURES[selectedId]?.system===state.system)selectStructure(selectedId,activeStructure(selectedId),false);else $("#detailCard").innerHTML=`<div class="empty-state">${tr("selectPart")}</div>`
    }
    function procedureNarration(){const s=PROCEDURE_STEPS[demo.index];return `${state.lang==="ta"?s.taTitle:s.enTitle}. ${state.lang==="ta"?s.ta:s.en}`}
    function renderProcedure(restart=false){
      const panel=$("#procedurePanel"),root=$("#procedureDemo"),btn=$("#procedureBtn");panel.hidden=!demo.active;btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded",String(demo.active));document.body.classList.toggle("procedure-active",demo.active);if(!demo.active){root.classList.remove("animate","opened");return}
      const s=PROCEDURE_STEPS[demo.index],last=demo.index===PROCEDURE_STEPS.length-1;root.dataset.step=String(demo.index);root.classList.toggle("opened",demo.index>=5);root.querySelectorAll("[data-reveal]").forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle("revealed",Number(el.dataset.reveal)<=demo.index));root.querySelectorAll("[data-active]").forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle("active",el.dataset.active.split(" ").includes(String(demo.index))));
      $("#procedureCounter").textContent=`${ptr("counter")} ${demo.index+1} ${ptr("of")} ${PROCEDURE_STEPS.length}`;$("#procedureHeading").textContent=state.lang==="ta"?s.taTitle:s.enTitle;$("#procedureText").textContent=state.lang==="ta"?s.ta:s.en;$("#procedureSafety").textContent=`⚠ ${ptr("safety")}`;$("#procedureSvgDesc").textContent=procedureNarration();$("#procedureProgress").value=demo.index+1;$("#procedurePrev").disabled=demo.index===0;$("#procedureNext").disabled=last;$("#procedurePrev").setAttribute("aria-label",ptr("previous"));$("#procedureNext").setAttribute("aria-label",ptr("next"));$("#procedureClose").textContent=`× ${ptr("close")}`;const playLabel=demo.playing?ptr("pause"):(last?ptr("replay"):ptr("play"));$("#procedurePlay").textContent=`${demo.playing?"❚❚":"▶"} ${playLabel}`;$("#procedurePlay").setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(demo.playing));
      if(restart){root.classList.remove("animate");requestAnimationFrame(()=>root.classList.add("animate"))}else root.classList.add("animate")
    }
    function clearProcedureTimer(){clearTimeout(demo.timer);demo.timer=null;demo.run=(demo.run||0)+1}
    function openProcedure(){clearProcedureTimer();demo.active=true;demo.index=0;demo.playing=false;state.system="setup";state.mode="guided";state.tool=null;renderAll();renderProcedure(true);play("select");speak(procedureNarration());$("#procedurePanel").scrollIntoView({block:"nearest"})}
    function closeProcedure(focus=true){stopSpeech();clearProcedureTimer();demo.active=false;demo.playing=false;renderProcedure();renderLayer();updateA11y();if(focus)$("#procedureBtn").focus()}
    function scheduleProcedure(){clearProcedureTimer();if(!demo.playing)return;const run=demo.run,started=Date.now();speak(procedureNarration()).then(result=>{if(run!==demo.run||!demo.active||!demo.playing)return;if(result==="error"||result==="cancelled"){demo.playing=false;renderProcedure();return}demo.timer=setTimeout(()=>{if(run!==demo.run||!demo.playing)return;if(demo.index>=PROCEDURE_STEPS.length-1){demo.playing=false;renderProcedure();return}demo.index++;play(demo.index===1||demo.index===2?"pin":demo.index===3?"scissors":"select");renderProcedure(true);scheduleProcedure()},Math.max(650,5200-(Date.now()-started)))})}
    function toggleProcedurePlay(){if(!demo.active){openProcedure();return}if(demo.playing){demo.playing=false;clearProcedureTimer();stopSpeech();renderProcedure();return}if(demo.index>=PROCEDURE_STEPS.length-1)demo.index=0;demo.playing=true;renderProcedure(true);scheduleProcedure()}
    function moveProcedure(delta){if(!demo.active)return;demo.playing=false;clearProcedureTimer();demo.index=Math.max(0,Math.min(PROCEDURE_STEPS.length-1,demo.index+delta));renderProcedure(true);play(demo.index===1||demo.index===2?"pin":demo.index===3?"scissors":"select");speak(procedureNarration())}
    function renderTabs(){const root=$("#systemTabs");root.innerHTML=Object.entries(SYSTEMS).map(([id,s])=>`<button class="seg-btn" type="button" data-system="${id}" aria-pressed="${state.system===id}"><span class="sys-icon" aria-hidden="true">${s.icon}</span>${state.lang==="ta"?s.ta:s.en}</button>`).join("")}
    function renderModes(){const modes=state.system==="setup"?["guided","assessment"]:["guided","explore","assessment","review"];if(!modes.includes(state.mode))state.mode="guided";$("#modeButtons").innerHTML=modes.map(m=>`<button class="seg-btn" type="button" data-mode="${m}" aria-pressed="${state.mode===m}">${m==="review"?REVIEW_UI[state.lang].mode:tr(m)}</button>`).join("")}
    function renderTools(){const hidden=["assessment","review"].includes(state.mode);$("#tools").parentElement.hidden=hidden;$("#tools").innerHTML=Object.entries(TOOLS).map(([id,t])=>`<button class="tool-btn" type="button" data-tool="${id}" aria-pressed="${state.tool===id}"><span aria-hidden="true">${t.icon}</span><span>${state.lang==="ta"?t.ta:t.en}</span></button>`).join("")}
    function renderLayer(){$$(".layer").forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("active",x.id===`layer-${state.system}`));renderExternalView();const section=["crosssection","respiratory"].includes(state.system);$("#bodyBase").style.display=section||state.system==="external"?"none":"inline";$("#bodyShadow").style.display=section?"none":"inline";$("#segments").style.display=section?"none":"inline";$("#internalFlaps").style.display=["setup","external","crosssection","respiratory"].includes(state.system)?"none":"inline";clearHighlights();renderSelection();if(state.mode==="guided"&&!demo.active)highlightCurrent()}
    function clearHighlights(){$$(".svg-structure").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("targeted"));$("#targetOverlay").innerHTML=""}
    function renderSelection(preferred=null){$$(".svg-structure.selected").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("selected"));$("#selectionOverlay").innerHTML="";if(!selectedId)return;const el=activeStructure(selectedId);if(el)el.classList.add("selected")}
    function currentStep(){const list=MODULES[state.system]||[];const i=Math.min(state.steps[state.system]||0,list.length);return {list,i,step:list[i]}}
    function highlightCurrent(){const {step}=currentStep();if(!step)return;const el=activeStructure(step.target);if(el)el.classList.add("targeted")}
    function renderInstruction(){const box=$("#instructionCard");if(state.mode==="assessment"){renderAssessment(box);return}if(state.mode==="review"){renderReview(box);return}if(state.mode==="explore"){box.innerHTML=`<div class="eyebrow">${state.lang==="ta"?SYSTEMS[state.system].ta:SYSTEMS[state.system].en}</div><h3>${tr("explore")}</h3><p>${tr("selectPart")}</p><div class="feedback">${state.lang==="ta"?"ஒவ்வொரு அமைப்பையும் தேர்ந்தெடுத்து, அதன் அமைவிடம், பணி மற்றும் விளக்கக் குறிப்புகளைப் படிக்கலாம். விரும்பினால் குரல் விளக்கத்தையும் கேட்கலாம்.":"Select each landmark for its location, function, scientific correction and optional narration."}</div>`;return}const {list,i,step}=currentStep(),done=i>=list.length;if(done){box.innerHTML=`<div class="eyebrow">${tr("complete")}</div><h3>${state.lang==="ta"?SYSTEMS[state.system].ta:SYSTEMS[state.system].en}</h3><p>${state.lang==="ta"?"இந்தப் பயிற்சி வரிசை முழுமையாக நிறைவடைந்தது. ஆராய்தல் முறையில் உறுப்புகளை மீளாய்வு செய்யலாம் அல்லது மதிப்பீட்டைத் தொடங்கலாம்.":"The guided sequence is complete.     function localDatePlus(days=0){const d=new Date();d.setHours(12,0,0,0);d.setDate(d.getDate()+days);return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`}
    function reviewCandidates(){const today=localDatePlus(0);return Object.entries(STRUCTURES).filter(([,s])=>s.system===state.system).map(([id])=>id).filter(id=>!reviewView.seen.has(id)&&(reviewView.optional||!state.review[id]||state.review[id].due<=today))}

    function bind(){

      $("#langBtn").addEventListener("click",cycleLanguage);$("#soundBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>{state.sound=!state.sound;renderAll();if(state.sound)play("select")});$("#voiceBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>{state.voice=!state.voice;if(!state.voice)stopSpeech();renderAll()});$("#contrastBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>{state.contrast=!state.contrast;renderAll()});$("#procedureBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>demo.active?closeProcedure():openProcedure());$("#procedurePlay").addEventListener("click",toggleProcedurePlay);$("#procedurePrev").addEventListener("click",()=>moveProcedure(-1));$("#procedureNext").addEventListener("click",()=>moveProcedure(1));$("#procedureClose").addEventListener("click",()=>closeProcedure());$("#printAtlasBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>{document.body.classList.add("print-atlas");printDocument()});window.addEventListener("afterprint",()=>document.body.classList.remove("print-atlas","print-certificate"));$("#resetBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>{safeDialogOpen($("#resetDialog"));focusSoon("#confirmReset")});$("#confirmReset").addEventListener("click",resetAll);$$('[data-close-dialog]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>safeDialogClose(b.closest("dialog"))));if("speechSynthesis" in window)speechSynthesis.addEventListener?.("voiceschanged",refreshVoices);
      $("#zoomIn").addEventListener("click",()=>zoomBy(1.25));$("#zoomOut").addEventListener("click",()=>zoomBy(.8));$("#zoomReset").addEventListener("click",()=>{zoom=1;panX=panY=0;applyTransform()});
      const wrap=$("#canvasWrap"),endDrag=e=>{if(drag?.id===e.pointerId){drag=null;wrap.classList.remove("grabbing")}};wrap.addEventListener("wheel",e=>{if(!e.ctrlKey&&!e.metaKey)return;e.preventDefault();const r=wrap.getBoundingClientRect();zoomBy(e.deltaY<0?1.15:.87,e.clientX-r.left,e.clientY-r.top)},{passive:false});wrap.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{if(zoom<=1||e.target.closest("button"))return;drag={id:e.pointerId,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,px:panX,py:panY};wrap.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);wrap.classList.add("grabbing")});wrap.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{if(!drag||drag.id!==e.pointerId)return;if(Math.hypot(e.clientX-drag.x,e.clientY-drag.y)>6)suppressClickUntil=performance.now()+400;panX=drag.px+e.clientX-drag.x;panY=drag.py+e.clientY-drag.y;applyTransform()});wrap.addEventListener("pointerup",endDrag);wrap.addEventListener("pointercancel",endDrag);
      window.addEventListener("pagehide",saveState,{capture:false});
    }
    initSegments();bind();bindEnhancements();if(!storageAvailable())showStorageWarning();$("#langBtn").textContent=state.lang==="en"?"EN":"தமிழ்";renderAll();applyTransform();
  })();
  </script>



</body>
</html>
